description: This file contains SQL statements to enable Row Level Security (RLS) on various core tables of a PostgreSQL database, define access policies based on organization memberships and user roles, and includes a helper function to retrieve the current user ID from JWT claims or session settings. It is part of a database migration script for setting up security policies in a multi-tenant environment.

methods.name: public.get_current_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID of the current user from the JWT claims or session GUC. It checks custom claim 'app.user_id', then the standard 'sub' claim, and falls back to a session variable if claims are unavailable.

calls: alter table ... enable row level security
